name: Skardu
subtitle: Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan
intro: Skardu is a town in the region of the same name in Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. Baltistan's five valleys – Shigar, Skardu, Khaplu, Rondu and Kharmang – host an incomparable cluster of mountain peaks and glaciers, and are noted for their luscious peaches, apricots, apples and pears.
